headline: SFG @ CHC matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SFG 3.50 at CHC 5.13, with a projected total of 8.63. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHC: SFG moved -0.42 runs while CHC moved +1.05, changing the projected margin by -1.48 runs. The projected total climbed +0.62, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +10.5%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Ben Brown has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jung Hoo Lee, Pete Crow-Armstrong, Bryce Eldridge, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Buddy Kennedy, Kevin Alcántara because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
